description: This file contains functions for sanitizing chat message envelopes, extracting sender labels, and removing metadata from messages in a chat application.

methods.name: extractMessageSenderLabel
methods.description: Extracts the sender label from a chat message entry, checking various fields and nested content.

methods.name: stripEnvelopeFromContentWithRole
methods.description: Removes envelope metadata from content array items, optionally stripping user envelope hints.

methods.name: stripEnvelopeFromMessage
methods.description: Sanitizes a single message object by removing envelope and metadata based on role.

methods.name: stripEnvelopeFromMessages
methods.description: Processes an array of messages, stripping envelopes and metadata from each.
